Subtitle: Duplicate contacts & photos
Short Description: Find duplicate contacts and identical photos. Clear the app's own cache.
Full Description:
AGCleaner finds duplicates. It does not claim to do anything else.

DUPLICATE CONTACTS
AGCleaner reads your address book and groups the entries that describe the same person, matching on phone number, email address or name. Each group tells you which of the three it matched on, so you can judge it yourself. AGCleaner never edits, merges or deletes a contact — it asks for read access only, shows you what it found, and stops there.

IDENTICAL PHOTOS
AGCleaner compares photos by content, not by appearance. Two photos are listed together only when their files are byte-for-byte identical, confirmed by a SHA-256 digest of the actual bytes. There is no "98% similar" score anywhere in the app, because nothing in it computes one, and a merely similar photo is a different photo. One copy in every group is always kept. You choose what goes, your device asks you to confirm it, and the total you are shown afterwards is the size of exactly the files the system reported it removed.

APP CACHE
The Cache tab measures AGCleaner's own temporary directory and can empty it. The figure is a real byte count taken by walking that directory, and the amount freed is the difference measured after the delete. No other app is touched.

WHAT IT CANNOT DO
AGCleaner cannot free system memory, cannot clear another app's data, and cannot report your device's total free storage. Apps on iOS and Android are not permitted to do those things, so AGCleaner does not show a gauge pretending otherwise.

NO NETWORK
Every picture on screen is one of your own files. There is no account, no sign-in and no purchase, and the app sends nothing anywhere.

The interface is available in twelve languages, switchable from the globe in the header.

SEND MONEY
Enter an amount, choose the currency you are sending from and the currency the recipient receives, then add the recipient's name, with an email address and a note if you want them. CREDIT SCORE
Your score and the factors behind it, drawn only from what the bureau returned. If a refresh does not actually complete, the gauge does not re-animate as though it did.

BORROW & PROTECT

Subtitle: Connection facts, measured
Short Description: Wi-Fi connection facts from your device, plus a real HTTPS speed test
Full Description:
WiFiTrail tells you what your device's connection actually is, and measures how fast it actually runs.

CONNECTION
The Connection tab reports the transport your device is using, straight from the operating system: Wi-Fi, cellular, ethernet, VPN, or several at once. On Wi-Fi it shows the network name and access point where the system releases them, and lists the IPv4 and IPv6 addresses this device holds on its own interfaces. Where the system withholds the network name, WiFiTrail says so and explains why instead of showing a placeholder. Refresh re-reads the OS, and the screen also updates itself when the connection changes.

SPEED TEST
The speed test transfers real bytes over HTTPS to and from Cloudflare's measurement endpoint. It reports download, upload, median ping and jitter, and prints the megabytes moved and the seconds taken underneath each figure so you can check the arithmetic. Before the first run every reading is a dash and the caption says it has not been measured. If a run is cancelled, times out, or fails, it ends with the reason and no number at all.

SECURITY
Five pieces of general Wi-Fi guidance, labelled as advice rather than a scan. WiFiTrail gives your network no score and no pass or fail, because it cannot inspect your router, firewall, DNS or open ports.

WHAT IT CANNOT DO
No app on iOS or Android is allowed to list the other networks around you, so WiFiTrail does not offer that, and it says so on screen rather than leaving an empty list. It reports no ISP, gateway, DNS or channel, because a sandboxed app cannot obtain them.

PERMISSIONS AND PRIVACY
Location is requested for one reason: the system releases the Wi-Fi network's name to an app only once that permission is granted. WiFiTrail takes no location fix, stores no location and sends none. There is no account, no sign-in, no ads and no analytics, and nothing leaves your device except the speed test's own traffic. Deny location and everything else still works.

LANGUAGES
The interface is translated into twelve languages: English, Arabic, Chinese, French, German, Hindi, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian and Spanish. It follows your device language, and a picker in the app overrides it.
